description.value: Royal Garden is Vernon's oldest Chinese restaurant, a family-owned establishment founded in 1995 by Li and Ken Low, whose ancestors were among the Chinese workers who helped build the Okanagan's first railroad. Now run by their daughter Susie, the restaurant serves North American Chinese cuisine from a spacious Anderson Way location with free parking and wheelchair accessibility. Dine-in, takeout, and buffet options make it a versatile stop for cyclists wanting a substantial sit-down meal in Vernon.

No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site; OSM tags also provide no such evidence.
